Attach a per-action red_card flag to possession chains (#93)

Source: R/wp_model.R
add_red_card_to_chains.Rd

SPADL carries only on-ball gameplay actions, so card events (Opta type_id == 17) are filtered out in convert_opta_to_spadl() and never reach the possession chains. As a result the red-card block in create_wp_features (if ("red_card" %in% names(dt))) always took its else branch and red_card_diff was a constant 0 – a dead feature. This helper re-derives red cards from the RAW events and joins a 0/1 red_card column onto the chains so that block activates.

Usage

add_red_card_to_chains(chains, events)

Arguments

chains

Possession chains (output of create_possession_chains()). Must contain match_id, team_id, time_seconds, period_id.

events

Raw Opta match events with match_id, type_id, team_id, minute, qualifier_json (and optionally second, period_id).

Value

chains with an integer red_card column (1 on the action nearest each carded team's red-card time, else 0). If no reds are detected (or required columns are missing) every row gets red_card = 0, which reproduces the previous constant-0 behaviour for that match.

Details

Detection mirrors extract_player_timing_from_events() in splint_creation.R: type_id == 17 (Card) carrying qualifier 33 (straight red) or 32 (second yellow). The earliest such card per (match, team) is taken, and the flag is set on the single chain action of the carded team nearest that card's time (matching the SPADL clock, time_seconds = minute*60 + second). One flagged action per red card is exactly what create_wp_features' cumsum() logic expects.

See also

Other possession chains: create_possession_chains()
